final_classification: RELIEF MULTI-TOILET FACILITY MODEL — ADJUDICATED / IMPLEMENTATION NOT AUTHORIZED
tfl_classification_preserved: RELIEF TFL REAL FEED — RECONCILED / PRODUCTION APPLY NOT AUTHORIZED

schema_findings.facility_row_contract: One published facilities row is the map/search/detail/discovery object, but the schema does not enforce whether it represents a venue, one toilet, or an aggregate provision.
schema_findings.provenance: facility_sources is strongly facility_id-linked and field_provenance is JSONB; no child/source-unit table exists.

existing_duplicate_signal.interpretation: Evidence that facility identity and physical toilet identity are not interchangeable; not asserted duplicate or unit counts.

affected_tables.integrity_decision: Keep facility_sources parent-only; use separate non-null toilet_unit_sources.toilet_unit_id rather than nullable polymorphic ownership.

affected_rpcs_and_queries.required_future_change: Keep map/nearest parent-shaped; add child-aware filters/detail queries only after schema and RLS authorization.

rationale: The current one-row model cannot losslessly represent multiple toilet types, gateline positions, textual locations, or unit-specific access/opening differences.
TfL has 410 rows across 179 stations and 147 stations with multiple rows; stable source identity is not physical-unit identity.
An additive optional child model preserves current facility IDs and parent-oriented app contracts.
Source-only records remain available for unresolved relationships and future providers.

model_classification.KEEP_CURRENT_MODEL: Compatibility-only; insufficient for canonical unit-level promotion.
model_classification.INTRODUCE_TOILET_UNIT_MODEL: RECOMMENDED; additive parent plus optional unit plus unit-source records.
model_classification.SOURCE_SUBRECORD_MODEL: Interim/fallback evidence model; insufficient for unit-aware UX and filters.
model_classification.GENERALIZED_PROVISION_GRAPH: Not selected; excessive scope and migration risk for this batch.

identity_rules.parent: Stable authoritative venue/station identity first; then existing provenance; then normalized name/address/postcode/town with operator context; coordinates supporting only; human review on conflict.

tfl_source.physical_identity_warning: Source identity is not proof of a distinct physical room.

identity_rules.default_multi_row_handling: SOURCE_DISTINCT_PHYSICAL_UNKNOWN or UNRESOLVED absent independent physical evidence
identity_rules.distance_rule: Distance alone never creates a parent or unit identity.

attribute_ownership.aggregate_semantics: At least one explicitly known unit; never every unit and never a silent overwrite of legacy parent booleans.

feature_impacts.favourites: NO_CHANGE in phase 1; UI_CHANGE for any future unit favourites
feature_impacts.reports: SCHEMA_CHANGE for unit-specific reports; parent-only phase 1 can remain unchanged
feature_impacts.ratings_reviews: NO_CHANGE now; SCHEMA_CHANGE if reviews are implemented
feature_impacts.account_export_deletion: QUERY_CHANGE if unit-linked user contributions are introduced

ui_contract.search: One parent result; show child count only when explicit children exist.
ui_contract.details: Parent summary plus optional explicit unit list with confidence/unknown labels.
ui_contract.filters: Existential child semantics for at-least-one capability; unknown is not false.
ui_contract.reports: Venue closure targets parent; one-unit closure targets child only when child exists.
ui_contract.favourites: Parent venue by default. Unit favourites require a separate product decision.
ui_contract.urgent_journey: Parent nearest lookup remains fast; child detail is secondary.

migration_recommendation.strategy: Additive phases: optional toilet_units; separate toilet_unit_sources; selected-provider source population; selective canonical promotion.
migration_recommendation.existing_facilities: Do not reinterpret or rewrite the 15,620 facilities.
migration_recommendation.legacy_semantics: Zero explicit children means facility with unit detail unknown, not exactly one toilet.

source_link_recommendation.facility_sources: Remain parent-only with strong facility_id foreign key.
source_link_recommendation.toilet_unit_sources: Separate table with non-null toilet_unit_id, unique source_name/source_record_id, source metadata, raw data, and governed RLS.
source_link_recommendation.nullable_polymorphic_source_table: REJECTED due to weak integrity and ambiguous RLS/uniqueness.
source_link_recommendation.unresolved_source_rows: Preserve as source evidence/quarantine until parent and physical relationship are resolved.

tfl_impact.overlap_note: The 328 collision rows are included in the 338 unresolved positional/model rows; counts are not additive.
tfl_impact.expected_net_new_facilities: NOT ASSERTED by this adjudication; the frozen 58 is not an approval count under the recommended model.

performance.parent_map_search_nearest: Retain parent-shaped reads and parent distance.
performance.child_filters: Use indexed EXISTS/aggregates or a maintained parent summary; avoid child fan-out in map payloads.

security_rls.public_read: Published parent and intentionally public child/source data only.
security_rls.moderation: Preserve server-derived reviewer and replay/ownership protections.

unresolved_questions: Define independent evidence for physical toilet units.
Choose exact child schema, status, confidence, and quarantine design.
Decide whether unit-targeted reports/corrections are phase 1.
Define future review/rating target; no active reviews table exists.
Authorize a governed canonical-application policy separately from moderation review.

coverage: source rows do not prove rooms
